specs.Camera-wiki: Ensign Focal Plane Roll Film Reflex
specs.英文简介: The Ensign Focal Plane Roll Film Reflex, also sold as the Speed Film Reflex, p402.[http://www.earlyphotography.co.uk/site/entry_C536.html Focal Plane Roll Film Reflex] with 4-inch f/3.4 Aldis-Butcher Anastigmat, at [http://www.earlyphotography.co.uk/index.html Early Photography] is an SLR camera for 2¼x3¼-inch exposures on 120 film, made by Houghton from about 1928 to 1936.
